## How to read these

**Immutable.** A published release is not edited. If something in it was wrong,
that appears as a correction in a later release, with the original left standing.
An archive that quietly improves itself is not an archive.

**Certification is published whether or not it passes.** Both builds so far have
failed their own harness. Publishing anyway is a deliberate choice, stated each
time, on the grounds that a map with its holes marked is more useful than no map
— but the verdict is never softened to make that easier.

**Method changes and market changes are different things.** From the September
release onward, the changelog separates reclassification caused by a change in
our own rules from movement in the world. A count that moved because we changed
the definition is not a finding about the field.

## Cadence

Monthly, from September 2026. September applies the
[stage inclusion tests](../method.html) and is therefore a **method migration** —
its diff will be dominated by our own rule changes rather than by the market.
October is the first month-over-month comparison that means anything, and only
if no further method changes land in it.

There is no changelog yet. Both builds carry the same date, so no month-over-month
pair exists to diff.
